title: Leaks: Samsung Preparing a Nearly Bezel-Free Display! 📱
body: Leaks: Samsung Preparing a Nearly Bezel-Free Display! 📱
New leaks suggest Samsung is considering launching flagship Galaxy phones with a screen almost completely free of bezels, in a fierce design race with Apple, which is working on a similar design.
But be careful: the leak itself gives the report only a 50% reliability rating — plans could change before launch.
Do you prefer a bezel-free screen, or do you worry about breakage? 😅
